name: tidesmith
description: Tidesmith: house standards and verification for agent-authored human-facing prose.

interface.shortDescription: Write and check human-facing prose to house standards.
interface.longDescription: Tidesmith holds the portable register, evidence discipline, and post-draft edit passes for prose that agents write to people, and the adversarial pass that checks a finished draft before it ships.
defaultPrompt: Use $tidesmith:writing-for-people to ground the draft in what was actually run, decided, and asked, then draft or edit this human-facing text so it opens on the point, makes one graded ask, claims only what the brief supports, and passes the edit checklist before sending.
